versions.content: Number of occurrences of containers, parameters and ref- erences in the ECU Configuration Value description To be able to specify how often a specific configuration element (container, parameter or reference) may occur in the ECU Configuration Value description the class EcucDefinitionElement is introduced. With the two attributes lowerMultiplicity and upperMultiplic- ity the minimum and maximum occurrence of the configuration element is specified.
